name: Jacquemus
why: Provençal sun, sculptural ease, social-native theater.
origin: Simon Porte Jacquemus, 2009 — founded at 19 and named for his late mother, Valérie Jacquemus.
opview: Positions sun, simplicity, and his mother's memory as the whole brand.

onething.n: Jacquemus attaches to collections and to bags, and the menswear changes shape every season without a garment recurring. Le Chouchou is a show, not a model

notes.fren: the South of France as product — sun, salt, his mother's name
